verses.sanskrit:
गन्धर्व उवाच।
              अथ तस्यामदृश्यायां नृपतिः काममोहितः। पातनः शत्रुसङ्घानां पपात धरणीतले॥१॥
verses.english: The Gandharva said : On the disappearance of the maiden, that chastiser of foes the king, being deprived of his senses by desire, fell on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमावथ सा चारुहासिनी। पुनः पीनायतश्रोणी दर्शयामास तं नृपम्॥२॥
verses.english: On his falling down on the ground, that maiden of sweet smiles and of swelling and round hips, appeared again before the king.

verses.sanskrit: अथाबभाषे कल्याणी वाचा मधुरया नृपम्। तं कुरूणां कुलकरं कामाभिहतचेतसम्॥३॥
verses.english: The blessed beauty (Tapati) then spoke to that king, the perpetuator of the Kuru race, these sweet words.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं तपती हसतीव सा। उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं ते न त्वमर्हस्यरिन्दम॥४॥
verses.english: Sweetly smiling, Tapati spoke thus in sweet words, “Rise, rise, O chastiser of foes be blessed. O best of kings, you are celebrated in the word, it does not befit you to lose your senses.” Having been thus addressed by her in these sweet words,

verses.sanskrit: मोहं नृपतिशार्दूल गन्तुमाविष्कृतः क्षितौ। एवमुक्तोऽथ नृपतिर्वाचा मधुरया तदा॥५॥
ददर्श विपुलश्रोणीं तामेवाभिमुखे स्थिताम्। अथ तामसितापाङ्गीमाबभाषे स पार्थिवः॥६॥
verses.english: The king (opening his eyes) saw before him that maiden of swelling hips. The king then addressed that black eyed maiden thus,

verses.sanskrit: मन्मथाग्निपरीतात्मा सन्दिग्धाक्षरया गिरा। साधु त्वमसितापाङ्गि कामार्तं मत्तकाशिनि॥७॥
verses.english: In accents weak with emotion and his heart burning with the fire of desire, “O black eyed beauty. O excellent lady, be blessed. I am burning with desire; and I, therefore, solicit you. Accept me, my life is ebbing away. O lady of large eyes, O lotus eyed beauty, it is all for (not having obtained) you. The god of love pierces me day and night with his arrows. O blessed lady, I have been bitten by Kama (the god of love) who is like a large snake.

verses.sanskrit: भजस्व भजमानं मां प्राणा हि प्रजहन्ति माम्। त्वदर्थं हि विशालाक्षि मामयं निशितैः शरैः॥८॥
कामः कमलगर्भाभे प्रतिविध्यन्न शाम्यति। दष्टमेवमनाक्रन्दे भद्रे काममहाहिना॥९॥
सा त्वं पीनायतश्रोणी मामाप्नुहि वरानने। त्वदधीना हि मे प्राणाः किन्नरोद्गीतभाषिणि॥१०॥
verses.english: O lady of faultless features, O lady of tapering things, O lady of sweet voice as that of the Kinnaris, have mercy on me; my life depends on you.
verses.bhavadeepa: अनाक्रन्दे अत्रातरि काले । ‘आक्रन्दः क्रन्दने ह्वाने मित्रदारुणयुद्धयोः । त्रातर्यपि च पुंसि स्यात्’ इति मेदिनी ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: चारुसर्वानवद्याङ्गि पद्मेन्दुप्रतिमानने। न ह्यहं त्वदृते भीरु शक्ष्यामि खलु जीवितुम्॥११॥
verses.english: O lady of beautiful and faultless features, O lady with the face like the lotus or the moon, O timid lady, I shall certainly be unable to live without you.

verses.sanskrit: कामः कमलपत्राक्षि प्रतिविध्यति मामयम्। तस्मात्कुरु विशालाक्षि मय्यनुक्रोशमङ्गने॥१२॥
verses.english: O lotus eyed lady, O lady of large eyes, the god of love is incessantly piercing me, be merciful towards me.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तं मामसितापाङ्गि न परित्यक्तुमर्हसि। त्वं हि मां प्रीतियोगेन त्रातुमर्हसि भामिनि॥१३॥
verses.english: O black eyed lady, you should not abandon me. O handsome lady, you should relieve me from such affliction by giving me your love.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्दर्शनकृतस्नेहं मनश्चलति मे भृशम्। न त्वां दृष्ट्वा पुनश्चान्यां द्रष्टुं कल्याणि रोचते॥१४॥
verses.english: O blessed beauty, at the very first sight, my heart has been captivated by you. My mind wanders. Seeing you, I do not like to cast my eyes on any other woman.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद वशगोऽहं ते भक्तं मां भज भाविनि। दृष्ट्वैव त्वां वरारोहे मन्मथो भृशमङ्गने॥१५॥
verses.english: O beautiful maiden, be merciful, I am your obedient (slave), (I am) your adorer; accept me. O beautiful lady, O large-eyed maiden, as soon as I saw you, he god of love,

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्गतं विशालाक्षि विध्यति स्म पतत्त्रिभिः। मन्मथाग्निसमुद्भूतं दाहं कमललोचने॥१६॥
verses.english: Entered my heart and he is piercing me with his arrows. O large eyed lady, O lotuseyed beauty, the great fire of desire is burning within me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतिसंयोगयुक्ताभिरद्भिः प्रह्लादयस्व मे। पुष्पायुधं दुराधर्षं प्रचण्डशरकार्मुकम्॥१७॥
verses.english: Extinguish that fire by throwing on it the water of your love. O beautiful lady, pacify, by becoming mine, the irrepressible god of love that has appeared here (in my heart) armed with bow and arrows; he pierces me incessantly with his sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्दर्शनसमुद्भूतं विध्यन्तं दुःसहैः शरैः। उपशामय कल्याणि आत्मदानेन भामिनि॥१८॥
गान्धर्वेण विवाहेन मामुपैहि वराङ्गने। विवाहानां हि रम्भोरु गान्धर्वः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते॥१९॥
verses.english: O beautiful featured maiden, O lady of tapering hips, marry me according to the Gandharva form, for of all kinds of marriage the Gandharva form has been said to be the best."

verses.sanskrit: तपत्युवाच। नाहमीशात्मनो राजन्कन्या पितृमती ह्यहम्। मयि चेदस्ति ते प्रीतिर्याचस्व पितरं मम॥२०॥
verses.english: Tapati said: O king, I am not the mistress of my ownself. Know me to be a maiden living under the control of my father. If you really love me, ask me of my father.

verses.sanskrit: यथा हि ते मया प्राणाः संगृहीता नरेश्वर। दर्शनादेव भूयस्त्वं तथा प्राणान्ममाहरः॥२१॥
verses.english: O king, you say that your heart has been robbed by me; but you too have robbed my heart at the first sight.

verses.sanskrit: न चाहमीशा देहस्य तस्मान्नृपतिसत्तम। समीपं नोपगच्छामि न स्वतन्त्रा हि योषितः॥२२॥
verses.english: O best of kings, I am not the mistress of my body; therefore I do not go near you. Women are never independent.

verses.sanskrit: का हि सर्वेषु लोकेषु विश्रुताभिजनं नृपम्। कन्या नाभिलषेन्नाथं भार्तारं भक्तवत्सलम्॥२३॥
verses.english: Is there any girl in the three worlds who would not desire for her husband such a king as you, kind to all your dependents and born of a noble race.
verses.bhavadeepa: तर्हि क्रियतां सङ्ग इति चेत्तत्राह । न चेति ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेवं गते काले याचस्व पितरं मम। आदित्यं प्रणिपातेन तपसा नियमेन च॥२४॥
verses.english: Therefore, when the opportunity comes, ask me of my father Aditya with due salutation, ascetic penances and vows.

verses.sanskrit: स चेत्कामयते दातुं तव मामरिसूदन। भविष्याम्यद्य ते राजन्सततं वशवर्तिनी॥२५॥
verses.english: O king, O chastiser of foes, if my father bestows me on you then asked, I shall ever be your obedient (wife).

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि तपती नाम सावित्र्यवरजा सुता। अस्य लोकप्रदीपस्य सवितुः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥२६॥
verses.english: My name is Tapati, I am the younger sister of Savitri. O best of Kshatriyas, I am the daughter of Surya, the illuminator of the Universe.
